title: Promisingpreneur
tagline: SUPPORTING THE NEXT GENERATION OF CREATIVES IN LEARNING, EARNING, AND LEVERAGING WITH NFT MEMBERSHIPS
description:
The Promisingpreneur collection comprises 2 NFT collections one being able to educate and become a proof of education that unlocks which our collection supports young creatives across the world to learn online. As Schools do not educate our young people about entrepreneurship or emotional intelligence or how to better navigate the world which sets apart the privileged and underprivileged. A lot of our underprivileged communities are extremely creative. However, due to not being exposed to privileged information there is a higher chance of minority creators being exploited and having a difficult time consistently monetising. 
By teaching creatives how to interact with themselves, To monetise their creativity and Allowing creatives to leverage new opportunities we will solve these issues. Our research has concluded that creatives have a difficult time in school and generally have high-functioning minds. meaning that we have to teach creatives in a more immersive way to make it more understandable. our mission is to provide education in the way creatives understand and not the way it has traditionally been done.  Our demographic covers all young people aged 12-22 however young people in hard-to-reach areas, low-income families and minority groups will be a priority. We are using The Promisingpreneur podcast to draw this demographic in and funnel them into the NFT collection unlocking community benefits which then funnels them into our beta testing of CREATALIFE.
how_its_made: The Promisingprenuer Collection is an interactive educational tool hosted on the Ethereum virtual machine. The tech is made up of an integrated web3 application and two NFT collections. The entire project is hosted on the scale this is due to the fact that it's free to the user and fits our desired audience. On the landing site, we used wallet connect due to its clean and fast interface. Likewise, we are hosting our live streaming educational content on LivePeer. This is because the hosting is free and integrated with sales.
